title: ctier decision record
description: An operation was classified and acted upon. Applied tier is determined; that is what distinguishes a Decision from an Attempt. deploymentDigest identifies the deployment that produced the decision — composed description, tier declarations, and declared agent identities — and is renamed from composition so a 0.1.0 record is obviously old. 0.2.0 follows 0.1.0 by days because 12b promoted these formats as normative, not stable, and reserved 1.0.0 for the point at which a second implementation has been held to them; this is that case. This format reaches 1.0.0 when an implementation other than the reference one has been held to records in it. Until then it is normative — it defines what a Decision is — but it has only ever been read by its author, which is a weaker claim than stability.
